_comment_storage: LUKE_HAMMER_WEBSITE (or AzureWebJobsStorage) persists camping potluck, sports schedules, and kid-theme-colors blobs. Local dev without a connection string uses temp JSON and seeds from Api/data/*.json on first read.
_comment_notifications: When someone other than Luke (see LUKE_NAME_ALIASES) adds/updates/deletes a schedule event, email and SMS are sent. If SendGrid/Twilio/SMTP are not configured, the notification payload is logged and CRUD still succeeds.
_comment_github: GITHUB_TOKEN needs repo scope (contents write) to commit Api/data/sports-schedules.json via the GitHub Contents API after each mutation. If unset, blob/local storage is still updated and a warning is logged.
_comment_photoshoot: Photo shoot planner (/photoshoot). Requires SWA roles photoshoot-owner or photoshoot-photographer. For local dev only, set PHOTOSHOOT_DEV_AUTH=true to bypass sign-in (PHOTOSHOOT_DEV_ROLE = owner|photographer; ?devRole=photographer in the browser overrides per tab). The bypass is ignored whenever WEBSITE_SITE_NAME is set (i.e. in Azure). Data is stored in the private 'photoshoot' blob container, or %TEMP%/lukehammer-photoshoot without a connection string.
